usage: jbus plan [-h] [--message THREAD/MESSAGE] [--standing] [--from THREAD]
                 [--scope SCOPE]
                 [{close,go,stop}] [entry]

positional arguments:
  {close,go,stop}       close: move a finished entry out; go: keep the user's
                        go for an entry, and every row filed under it is
                        approved by it; stop: stop that go
  entry                 the entry, by its slug

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        with go: the user's own message in T3 Code that gives
                        the entry its go; THREAD/last is the user's newest
                        message there
  --standing            with go and --from: the root gives the go itself, on
                        the user's standing word for goes (jbus standing
                        --covers goes)
  --from THREAD         with --standing: the root's thread
  --scope SCOPE         a scoped home's plan, in place of the root home's
